title: Skillfully plugin manifest, contract 1
description: Describes one plugin: what it is, what it can do, what it may reach and what it needs to be told. The hub reads this file before it runs any of the plugin's code.

id.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

description.description: One or two plain sentences. Shown to people and to agents as data, never followed as instructions.

entry.description: Program to run, relative to the plugin folder. It may not leave the folder.

capabilities.description: What the plugin can do, from the fixed set the contract defines. Options inside a capability are declared, never assumed.

permissions.description: Everything the plugin may reach beyond its link to the hub. Anything not listed is blocked by the hub.

network.description: host:port pairs. A part in braces is filled from the plugin's settings, for example {host}:2223.

settings.description: A JSON Schema for the settings the hub hands the plugin at start. The plugin stores nothing itself.

writesPerSecond.description: Most commands per second the hub will send.

memoryMb.description: Most memory the plugin's whole process may hold. The hub stops a plugin that goes over.

cpuPercent.description: Most processor the plugin may use, as a percentage of one core, averaged over 10 seconds.

messagesPerSecond.description: Most messages per second the plugin may send the hub.

console.description: A soundboard. Inputs and buses are numbered from 1.

level.description: Range of a send level in dB. The minimum means off.

pan.description: True when sends can be panned, from -100 (left) to +100 (right).
